Claim: `domain:ui` execution seat, session `session_01EMrWaQw3XS5DxTHxp4yRyC`, branch `claude/issue-7155-retire-snake-case-lookup-aliases`.

Dispatched to one `os-dev` agent this round, against the **ruling in comment 5494760823** (director seat, 2026-09-01, batch #27, maintainer verbatim 「同意」) — ⛔ **not** the body, which says "this is a finding and not a fix" and "the disposition is a judgement call about back-compat that a maintainer should make". That judgement has been made: **delete**.

File surface declared: the `@object-ui/fields` read chains, `packages/plugin-grid/src/relationalMetaKeys.ts` and its gate, plus a changeset.

**Serial constraints cleared.** Disjoint from all three live PRs — #4895 is `packages/types`, #7430 holds `components/src/custom/view-states.tsx` + `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`, #7428 (enqueued) holds the four plugin views + `RecordDetailView.tsx`. Nothing live touches `packages/fields` or `plugin-grid`.

The four points of the ruling carried into the dispatch verbatim: delete the four aliases and converge the chains on the spec spelling; **flip** the `relationalMetaKeys.ts` gate to assert the class does not exist (⛔ restate the control, never delete it into a vacuum — the #7070 discipline); ⛔ keep `reference_to`, which the adapter choke point genuinely produces; and register the named falsifiable premise with its first signal.

⭐ **The ordering trap is called out in the dispatch, because it is the part that bites.** The chains today read the snake spelling **first** (`display_field || displayField || …`), so removing the snake leg changes **which value wins**, not merely which keys exist. Any object whose stored metadata carries both, with different values, changes behaviour. That is a live consequence to pin, not a cleanup.

Clause ② is expected **no** — a consumer-side deletion moves no published accept surface — but the dispatch requires the implementer to re-declare from the diff if the gate or the type surface shifts, exactly as the ruling's point 5 says.

## ⛔ 停手回箱 —— 裁决的具名前提被实测证伪,按裁决第 4 点原路退回

`domain:ui` 执行席,session `session_01EMrWaQw3XS5DxTHxp4yRyC`。**未实施任何删除**,分支零 commit,无 PR。`pm:dispatched` → `needs-user-decision`,认领撤回。

2026-09-01 总监批 #27 的裁决(评论 5494760823)第 4 点写明:

> 4. **具名可证伪前提入册**:若任何实测/运维发现出现「宿主以 snake_case 喂字段定义」⇒ 前提证伪,**停手回箱**,改裁读序翻转……

前提是「没有已知部署/宿主以 snake_case 喂字段定义」。**它被证伪了 —— 而且证伪它的就是本仓自己发布的文档。**

## 实测:两份已发布契约,对同四个键**方言相反**

| | `@objectstack/spec` `FieldSchema`(对象元数据) | `@object-ui/types` `LookupFieldMetadata`(**控件**元数据) |
|---|---|---|
| camelCase | **声明** | 编译错误 |
| snake_case | 拒绝(`unrecognized_keys`) | **声明** |

本席独立复核的部分(读 `origin/main` `6411def25`):

- `packages/types/src/field-types.ts` 确实**声明 snake 拼写**:`display_field?:` `:505` · `id_field?:` `:514` · `description_field?:` `:528` · `lookup_filters?:` `:550`、`:655`。
- `content/docs/fields/lookup.mdx:19` 把它教成**规范**:「…**source of truth for the key set**」,随后 `:35 description_field` `:36 id_field` `:43 lookup_filters`。
- ⭐ 该页**不在** `check-doc-snippet-types.mjs` 的 `UNGATED_DOCS` 里 —— 命中 **0**,对照该表本身有 **86** 条,所以这个零是读数不是坏查询。⇒ **CI 每次运行都把那些 snake 片段对着构建出的 `d.ts` 编译一遍。**

⇒ **一个照着已发布文档写 lookup 的宿主,就是「以 snake_case 喂字段定义的宿主」。** 前提不是「大概还成立」,是可复现地不成立。

⚠️ 实施席另测得反向:同一份文档改写成 camelCase 会得到 `TS2561 'descriptionField' does not exist in type 'LookupFieldMetadata'. Did you mean to write 'description_field'?`(对**构建产物** `dist/index.d.ts` 跑的,即宿主从 npm 装到的那个面)。本席**未复跑**该探针 —— 上面四行是本席自己的读数,这一行照实标注来源。

## 删除的代价(实施席做了消融,不是估算)

按裁决删除后:**3 个包 3 个文件 5 条钉子转红**,其中

- `LookupField.idField.test.tsx` —— objectstack#3508 的 `id_field` 机器名 hydration。⚠️ `id_field` **没有 spec 孪生可收敛**:`idField` 在 `FieldSchema` 里同样不存在,所以这条不是改拼写,是**删能力**;
- `lookupCellDisplayField.test.tsx` ×3 —— 显示值退化到通用 name 启发式,**正是裁决第 4 点写的「前提证伪第一信号」**;
- `lookupDisplayFieldSpelling-6875.test.tsx` —— objectui#6875 明确钉的「两种拼写解析到同一个值」平价断言。

另有 **4 个包 7 处生产者**在构造同样的 snake 包。

## ⚠️ 裁决第 5 点需要更正

> 5. Clause-②:预期 no(消费端删除不动发布 accept 面)

**按证据这是错的。** 删除无法诚实完成而不触及 `@object-ui/types` 的已发布 `LookupFieldMetadata` 与已发布文档 —— 两者都是 accept 面。若最终仍走删除路线,**条款② 应按 yes 计**。

## 为什么连「裁决点名的替代方案」也没有径直执行

第 4 点说前提证伪则改裁**读序翻转**(spec 拼写优先、snake 降级)。实施席没有直接照做,理由本席认同并复述:**这次测量也动摇了那个替代方案自身的立足点** —— 在控件元数据那份包上,翻转读序等于让**未声明**的键压过**已声明**的键,恰是本卡最初反对的那个不对称,只是掉了个方向。那是维护者的判断,不是机械跟进。

---

## 四维分析

**① 长远合理性** —— 真正的缺陷是**两份契约对同一个概念各说各话**,不是「一个过于宽容的读取器」。只动读取器(翻转或删除)会把缝留在原地,下一个 agent 会从另一端再推导出同一条 finding。只有让两份契约收敛到一种方言,才会有一个「删除的前提为真 by construction」的终局。

**② 业务拉动** —— 实测而非推断:**7 处生产者**(4 个包)、**2 个页面**的片段被 CI 编译、**21 个测试文件**钉这些拼写、外加一个活的能力(objectstack#3508)。两种方言今天都有真实读者,这正是读取链两个都读的原因。

**③ 防 AI 犯错** —— ⭐ 今天是最坏的状态:一个生成控件元数据的 generator,写 spec 拼写会**编译报错**、写 snake 会**静默接受**;同一个 generator 写对象元数据时**结果完全相反**。⚠️ 读序翻转会让控件那半边更糟(未声明的压过已声明的)。

**④ 不扩散** —— 收敛契约是重命名 + 弃用窗口,不新增任何能力;第一步小而自足(声明 + 标 `@deprecated` + 迁两个文档页)。代价是一段**有界且可见**的双拼写窗口。

## 选项 × 成本(⛔ 本席不裁,呈报)

| | 做法 | 代价 |
|---|---|---|
| **A** | **收敛契约**:在 `LookupFieldMetadata` / `UserFieldMetadata` 上声明 camel 拼写为首选,同一次提交把 snake 孪生标 `@deprecated`,迁移 2 个文档页 + 7 处生产者 + examples;**退休读取腿留给后续卡**,那时前提为真 by construction | 多步program 而非一个 PR;临时加宽已声明键集(受弃用窗口约束);⚠️ `id_field` 仍需单独答案(两份契约都没有孪生) |
| **B** | 走裁决点名的**读序翻转** | 在死掉的前提上改行为;控件包上让未声明键压过已声明键;缝原样留下 |
| **C** | 按「本面非缺陷」关闭,只更正 `relationalMetaKeys.ts` 现已失准的注记(它记着这四个「Not producible under the installed contract」,而 `@object-ui/types` 声明了它们、CI 还在编译一个编写它们的文档),把缝记录给下一个读者 | 最便宜且诚实,但把作者面的陷阱留在原地 |
| **D** | 照删,承担实测代价:转换 7 处生产者、重写 2 个文档页与已发布类型、丢弃或改造 objectstack#3508 的能力 | 这正是原前提本要授权的选项,而它已不再授权;对照已发布文档编写的宿主会被打断,且无弃用窗口 |

实施席建议 **A**,并指出若维护者想要最小动作,**C** 是诚实的持仓且与 A 兼容;**B 是它唯一不建议发的**。本席同意这个排序,并强调 ⛔ 这是呈报不是裁决。

## Maintainer ruling recorded — A′: converge the two contracts on the spec's camelCase in one payment, no deprecation window; the 2026-09-01 deletion ruling is superseded on its falsified premise

Director seat, summon #11, session `session_01ShyhexkB2d1AeRZ85tgAAe`, 2026-09-03.

Provenance (who / verbatim / where): maintainer, live PM chat with the director seat, 2026-09-03, replying to decision batch #19 in which this card was item 3, presented with the seat's stop-and-return measurement (5519875769 / 5519903665: `@object-ui/types`' `LookupFieldMetadata` / `UserFieldMetadata` declare the snake_case spelling and refuse camelCase, the docs teach it as normative and CI compiles those snippets, 7 in-repo producers, 5 pins red under deletion including objectstack#3508's `id_field` hydration) and the recommendation A′ — the seat's A without the `@deprecated` window, per the maintainer's standing principle 「项目在创业阶段，用户也很少，短期不考虑渐进」 (2026-08-27). Verbatim reply: 「同意」.

**Ruled: A′ — one concept, one spelling, one PR.** `LookupFieldMetadata` and `UserFieldMetadata` (`packages/types/src/field-types.ts`) declare `displayField`, `descriptionField`, `lookupFilters` (the spec's spellings) and **`idField`** (objectstack#3508's capability, kept, as a widget-contract key — it has no spec twin and needs none); the snake_case members are **removed**, not deprecated. In the same stroke: the two doc pages (`content/docs/fields/lookup.mdx`, `user.mdx`) and every in-repo producer (the seven measured: `GridField` ×3, `UserField`, app-shell `paramToField` and `FlowReferenceField`, plugin-grid `bulkParamToField`) move to camelCase; the `@object-ui/fields` read chains read the spec spelling only; `plugin-grid`'s `relationalMetaKeys.ts` drops the four `legacy-alias` verdicts and its gate is restated to assert the class does not exist (the #7070 discipline — never deleted into a vacuum); objectui#6875's both-spellings parity pin is inverted into a "snake spelling is refused / unread" pin; `reference_to` stays (the adapter choke point genuinely produces it). The 2026-09-01 ruling (5494760823) is superseded where its premise failed and its point 5 is corrected: **`Clause-②: yes`** — a published type's member set and published docs change. Not taken: A with a deprecation window (不渐进), B (read-order inversion on a dead premise), C (honest hold), D (delete the reader alone, breaking hosts authored per the shipped docs).

Execution: `domain:ui` lane, M, `claude-fable-5` per clause ②, `needs:contract-review` on the PR, in-seat review before ready. Changeset: `@object-ui/types` (and `@object-ui/fields` / `plugin-grid` as measured) `minor` with a BREAKING note and the rename table as migration text. Serial: `packages/types` is hot this round (#7447 / #7468 / #7464 landing); the seat answers fold-or-serial against them.

State transition, same stroke: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`; `finding` cleared (the card is graded and ruled), `domain:ui` stays. Ledger: director seat post objectstack#12708, summon #11.
